Workflow.Name: Chess Agent Turn Orchestration
Workflow.Description: Power Apps V2 orchestration for agent-owned chess turns. Validates authoritative Dataverse state and participant conversation ownership, resumes the published Chess Copilot agent, then confirms persisted progress and returns a typed Canvas response.
